notes.title: Dev Log#19
notes.content:
[h2]Junk Sledgehammer – The Weight That Demands Respect[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/2bbd03f2289d31a6920a941d81f6e88c08de5c36.png[/img]

The weapon we’re introducing this time is the [b]Junk Sledgehammer[/b].
At first glance, it may seem like nothing more than a chunk of iron,
but behind its crude form lies a great deal of careful thought.
With this weapon, we wanted to ask a question beyond raw strength
[b]“How do you handle this kind of weight?”[/b]

[h3]Answering the question: "Why did we make this?"[/h3]

Blunt weapons are notoriously difficult to handle in games.
They’re slow, heavy, and require precise timing.
But that’s exactly why we chose to make this hammer.
We wanted to create a weapon that could [b]turn the tide of battle with one strike[/b],
and a weapon where [b]the weight itself defines how you play[/b].

[h3]It’s heavy but not thrown together[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/04bdd34b9f0211fa6fa3ad0782520db3cf5707da.jpg[/img]

The head is based on steel structures used in actual railroads.
Both ends can be used for striking, and the forward-heavy balance delivers serious impact with each swing.

Instead of simple welding, we reinforced the core with bolts and nuts 
a functional solution we implemented after test builds revealed shaking and instability.

The handle is wrapped in duct tape, electrical tape, and a greasy rag.
These aren’t just for looks—they’re based on real survival tools for [b]grip and shock absorption[/b].

[h3]In-game role: A strike you can trust[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/ddfdb3537764d92b4cc32977c203028954f29eba.jpg[/img]

The Junk Sledgehammer is one of the heaviest two-handed weapons in the game.
It’s slow to swing, but [b]one hit can turn the tide[/b].
[b]Horizontal attacks[/b] push multiple enemies away and cause stagger—perfect for crowd control.
[b]Vertical strikes[/b] are effective against armored zombies and tanky enemies, dealing massive stagger or knockback, sometimes even fatal blows.

This weapon shines when:

Enemies rush you in tight interiors

You need silent but powerful impact

You're down to one last shot—[b]and it needs to count[/b]

[h3]Design Intent: Strategic weight players can feel[/h3]

The Junk Sledgehammer wasn’t created just to add another powerful weapon.
We wanted to give players the following experiences:

[b]1. A weapon that shifts combat rhythm[/b]
Unlike fast-striking weapons, this hammer [b]makes every hit a decision[/b].
You wait, read your opponent, and commit. We wanted every swing to feel like a moment.

[b]2. Control and spacing through impact[/b]
More than just damage, it’s a [b]tool to reset combat flow[/b] using knockback and stagger
letting players regain initiative and space.

[b]3. A last resort you can truly count on[/b]
Even when resources run out,
we wanted this weapon to offer the confidence that [b]you still have a way to survive[/b].
This isn't just a blunt object. It's a statement.

[h3]Comment[/h3]

The Junk Sledgehammer isn’t flashy,
but [b]it changes how you fight[/b].

It’s not easy to swing,
but landing the hit feels better than almost anything else.

If you’ve tried it out and have thoughts good or bad
come let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]Discord[/url].
Your feedback is the compass that guides us forward.

notes.title: 2nd Public Playtest Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors.  
Here are the details of the upcoming second public playtest.  
Check the details below.  

[h3][New Weapons & Weapon Rework][/h3]  
● [b]Scrap Spear[/b]: A new two-handed weapon, Scrap Spear, has been added.  
 → The Scrap Spear can perform thrust and slash attacks with strong attacks.  
● [b]Single-Barrel Shotgun[/b]: The Double-Barrel Shotgun has been reworked into a simple but powerful single-shot shotgun.  
● [b]Improved animations and hit feedback for some existing weapons.[/b]  
 → These improvements are ongoing, and this version is not final.  

[h3][New Zombies][/h3]  
● [b]Spitter[/b]  
 → Sprays toxic liquid from a distance, dealing continuous damage.  
 → If approached, it switches to melee attacks instead of ranged ones.  
 → Upon death, the Spitter explodes, leaving a toxic gas cloud.  

● [b]Crawler[/b]  
 → A legless zombie that crawls and attacks from below.  
 → Moves slowly but can ambush survivors unexpectedly.  

● [b]Charger[/b]  
 → Performs a powerful charge attack, dealing heavy damage on impact.  
 → Has high defense and is a major threat in close combat.  

[h3][Weapon Usage Experience & Controls Improvements][/h3]  
● [b]Parry System (Prototype)[/b]  
 → When wielding a Shovel, right-clicking now enables parrying.  
 → Successfully parrying an attack blocks damage and allows a counterattack.  
 → The parry system is still in early development and is currently limited to the *Shovel*.  

● [b]Bow Mechanism Improvement[/b]  
 → Bow handling and control have been refined.  
 → Input delay that felt inconvenient has been adjusted.  
 → Further improvements are in progress.  

● [b]Improved Controls[/b]  
 → Movement speed now transitions more smoothly when exiting ADS (aiming).  
 → Left/right leaning movement speed reductions have been adjusted.  

[h3][Item & System Improvements][/h3]  
● [b]Grinder Added[/b]  
 → A new system allows certain items to be converted into other items.  
 → Helps efficiently manage unnecessary inventory items.  
 → Available at the Liberty Grand Center (in-game).  
 → The system will continue to be refined based on feedback.  

● [b]Crafting Station Added[/b]  
 → All craftable items are now categorized for easier viewing.  
 → The crafting process has been made more intuitive.  

● [b]Storage Expansion[/b]  
 → The maximum number of storable items has increased.  
 → Additional storage expansion can be purchased with currency.  

[h3][Floor Rotation System][/h3]  
● The [b]lower and upper floors will rotate[/b] in 8-floor units at set intervals.  
● The [b]floor layout changes at specific times based on a global timer, requiring strategic adaptation.[/b]  
 → However, ongoing matches will not have floor changes even when the timer reaches its threshold.  
● Survivors will need to [b]adjust their tactics based on floor conditions[/b], making exploration and combat more engaging.  
 → For more details, refer to Dev Log #13.  
 → [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2795540/view/518574631175585941]Dev Log #13[/url]  

In addition to the changes listed in the update notes, various content improvements and fixes have been implemented.  
Join the final public playtest, experience the new content, and share your feedback!  

If you have any questions about the public test, please visit [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]The Midnight Walkers Discord[/url].  
Your feedback is invaluable for the future development of the game.  

Thank you.

notes.title: Dev Log #14
notes.content:
Introducing the new zombie "Charger," designed to fulfill the challenging desires of survivors like you.
This is not just a powerful zombie it’s a formidable foe that skilled survivors may find difficult to defeat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/d5161304c4be1cea5a8406f1d0922b181fab2b4f.png[/img]
The Charger is a mid boss tier zombie with an intense presence.
Each of its attacks is a serious threat, and without teamwork among squads, it is nearly impossible to take it down.
From its appearance to its abilities, everything about the Charger is designed to make your heart race.

[h2]1. The Charger’s Background[/h2]

As the virus caused the world to collapse, people sought refuge in what they believed to be a safe haven, Liberty Grand Center, located in Gold County.
But sadly, this was no ordinary refuge.
This location was controlled by "Mr. Nobody" and his organization, who seemed to be protecting survivors but were secretly conducting experiments behind the scenes.

Among those who sought safety at the refuge, individuals who enjoyed sports, were physically fit, or had strong physiques like rugby players became prime candidates for experiments.
For survivors with families, they were given the harsh choice: “Your life or your family’s?” On the other hand, for those without families, weaker individuals or even children were used as leverage, subjecting them to torture and threats to force participation in the experiments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/bd7727943df065ecef221c8e9787fe0dc488df59.png[/img]
Mr. Nobody’s goal was not only to create powerful zombies but also to study the various reactions of the virus through specific zombie transformations.
The results of these experiments produced creatures with entirely different traits and abilities compared to standard walkers.
Of these, the Charger was one of the most dangerous and powerful outcomes.

[h2]2. Charger’s Skills and Abilities[/h2]

The Charger possesses extraordinary abilities that exceed your expectations. Its charge skill is not only a threat but also a game-changer in battles. Its devastating attacks bring both tension and excitement.

● Key Features
- Close-range attacks
- Charging ability
- Charge combo
- Damage: Instant damage and knockback effect
- Health: Significantly higher than standard zombies
- Speed: Moderate movement speed; rapid acceleration during charges

Watch the test version video below for more details.
[previewyoutube=qVUGUxtWx3c;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]※ This footage was captured in the test version and may differ from the final release. ※[/b]
When it charges, survivors are highly advised to evade its path.

[h2]3. How to Deal with the Charger[/h2]

Battling the Charger without cooperation or experience can be extremely challenging.
Understanding its patterns and devising effective strategies will be key to success.
Prepare strong equipment and skills.
Most importantly, learning when to back off is the ultimate key to dealing the Charger.

[h2]4. Prepare to Face the Charger[/h2]

The Charger is here to make your heart pound and ignite your desire for a challenge.
Its overwhelming presence is not just that of an enemy—it’s a monumental challenge you must overcome, and that is our goal.
If you have any thoughts about the Charger, please feel free to leave your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]Discord[/url].

notes.title: 2025 New Year Greetings and Roadmap Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!
Happy New Year! This is Director Ray.

Throughout 2024, we received overwhelming support and expectations for The Midnight Walkers. Thanks to all of you, our development team, including myself, had an exciting year of development.

As we welcome the new year, I wanted to share some updates regarding our 2025 schedule. Rather than announcing it through a text notice, I thought it would be more personal to share the changes to the roadmap up to Q2 2025 via a video recorded in our meeting room.

[previewyoutube=0fLNeiZM1FA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]2025 Q2 Roadmap (Video Summary)[/h3]
● The January test has been postponed due to stabilization efforts and incomplete development tasks.
● We will not participate in Steam Next Fest in February but will conduct an open test during that period (this might be the final open test).
● In June, we will participate in Steam Next Fest and transition to Early Access immediately after.
● We have extended the development period by 3 months to incorporate feedback from the February test and to enhance server and database stability.
● The next update after the February test will be announced in March following the test's conclusion.
● From March to May, we may conduct a few closed tests.
● Details will be shared in advance via the Steam News channel and Discord.

We are sincerely grateful for your genuine interest and expectations. Moving forward, we will continue transparent communication and strive to create a robust game that you can enjoy for a long time.

Please keep sharing your feedback and stay engaged with us. 
Thank you.

Best regards,
Director Ray and the OneWayTicket DevTeam

notes.title: Dev Log #13
notes.content:
[h2]A Dynamic Experience: Floor Rotation System[/h2]
Survivors, Liberty Grand Center is evolving beyond a mere survival ground. It’s becoming a strategic battleground where tension and strategy collide. In this development diary, we’re excited to introduce our ongoing work on the Floor Rotation System, designed to deliver a thrilling and constantly changing survival experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/ae2f7ca240de513de39fef36061d961e6e941ed4.png[/img]

[h2]1. Overview of the Floor Rotation System[/h2]
The Floor Rotation System aims to achieve the following goals, while Liberty Grand Center will eventually expand to over 24 floors with more themed battle zones in development:

Offer new exploration opportunities with diverse floors to enhance gameplay experiences.
Create unpredictable scenarios to amplify tension and immersion.
Design ever-changing routes to make each session feel fresh and engaging.
This system will rotate the available floors at fixed intervals, encouraging survivors to embrace new challenges with each rotation.

[h2]2. Core Design Features[/h2]
Survivors can preview the current active floors and the upcoming rotation in advance, with battle grounds remaining fixed for a set duration.

● Rotation Timer
At the end of each interval, the active floor range will automatically shift to new levels. Survivors will see a real-time countdown to the next rotation.
For example, matches may initially occur on lower floors (B1-7F) for 10 minutes, before shifting to upper floors (8F-16F), offering new routes and strategies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/c049f39c213c432981c7c282037dff0a0f18034f.png[/img]
Our ultimate goal is to ensure seamless and uninterrupted gameplay by minimizing split matchmaking pools.

● Global Synchronization
To maintain a fair gaming environment, the active floor ranges will be synchronized globally for all survivors. This design prevents fragmented matchmaking and ensures everyone shares the same experience.

[h2]3. Enhanced UI and User Experience[/h2]
The Floor Rotation System will be accompanied by an intuitive UI, ensuring a smooth experience for survivors. Separate floor ranges will be designated for solo and team modes. Below is a preview of the updated UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/ce91d5bbbaf82c2a7b8ab0a9d5d4f7de75da4a41.png[/img]
[b]Please note: The UI shown is still under development and not final.[/b]

●  Current and Upcoming Floor Information
For example, the team mode may currently be active on floors B1-7F, with the next rotation scheduled for floors 8F-15F. Survivors can plan their strategies using clear, real-time information on when the rotation will occur.

[h2]4. Changes the System Will Bring[/h2]
As mentioned, Liberty Grand Center will see the addition of more themed floors over time. The rotation system’s ultimate goal is to deliver fresh and exciting experiences every time survivors enter the game.

Elevators and staircases will play a critical role. Some floors may restrict access to these features, forcing survivors to rethink their strategies. Furthermore, we’re exploring the possibility of random events occurring in certain areas to inject moments of unpredictable tension.

[h2]5. Future Plans[/h2]
The Floor Rotation System is currently in its early stages of design and testing. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us in refining and enhancing this feature.

Your thoughts and ideas inspire us every day. Please feel free to share your feedback and suggestions on our [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]Discord channel[/url].
Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Dev Log#12
notes.content:
Survivors, get ready to face a new kind of threat in Liberty Grand Center, one that goes beyond mere survival.
The upcoming new zombie, the Crawler, currently under development, will deliver a whole new level of tension unlike anything you’ve faced before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/ca911846c33ce15a89ecaefadab0c519846abb38.png[/img]
This zombie drags itself across the ground with just its upper body but relentlessly pursues survivors.
What seems like a weakness—its missing lower body—becomes its strength, allowing it to appear unpredictably from places like floor ducts or ceiling vents.
The Crawler will disrupt survivors’ escape plans, turning Liberty Grand Center into an even more intense battleground.

[h2]The Design of the Crawler[/h2]

Liberty Grand Center isn’t just a backdrop; it’s a living, breathing stage where survivors and zombies clash in relentless tension. Below is the modeling image of the Crawler, showcasing how much attention and caution it demands from survivors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/878a4a8af2b5306927e5d1c4fc53e87ad96dbe6f.png[/img]
With its torn flesh, exposed organs, and grotesquely twisted body, the Crawler is the epitome of terror.
Our modeling work focused on visually amplifying their desperation and aggression.
From the way their claws scrape the ground to their exposed spine and entrails, everything about the Crawler is designed to evoke unease and fear.

[h2]A New Layer of Horror Gameplay[/h2]

The Crawler isn’t just another zombie. Its movement and attack style will challenge survivors in entirely new ways:

Ambush Attacks: Appearing suddenly from ducts, ceilings, or other unexpected locations, they create chaos and confusion.
Low-Profile Movement: Their low crawling motion makes them harder to hit, especially in confined spaces.
[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Like all our other content, the Crawler is currently under active development and testing as we prepare for its first encounter with survivors.
Our development team is committed to ensuring that the Crawler brings fresh changes to combat and strategy.
With the introduction of the Crawler and other exciting updates, we’re dedicated to making your gameplay experience even more dynamic.

Your feedback is always a great inspiration to us.
If you have ideas, share them with us through our [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]Discord[/url].
Thank you!

notes.title: Dev Log#11
notes.content:
[h2]1. Single Barrel Shotgun[/h2]

Our development team envisioned what it would feel like for survivors to hold this weapon in the post-apocalyptic world of The Midnight Walkers. We aimed to create more than just a gun — we wanted to portray the "will to survive" that emerges in a desolate world.

In the previous test, survivors had access to the Double Barrel Shotgun. While its powerful firepower captured players' attention, it also presented an unexpected overbalance issue. As a result, other weapons were overshadowed, pushing our team to rethink the situation.

Ultimately, the team decided not to abandon the shotgun entirely but to refine it. By transitioning to the Single Barrel Shotgun, we aimed to retain the shotgun's strengths while encouraging survivors to make more deliberate and strategic decisions.

[h2]2. Modeling Changes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/ed292b5827691cd2ba398fc04802be99bae10292.png[/img]  
Here is the updated model of the Single Barrel Shotgun. To preserve the original atmosphere, we incorporated rusty metal pipes, worn leather, and aged tape to reflect the hardships and struggles of survival.

[h2]3. Performance Changes[/h2]

The Single Barrel Shotgun fires only one round at a time, but that single shot represents a survivor's decisive judgment. Every shot carries weight, making each decision meaningful.  
With the shift to a single shot, the reload speed has slightly improved compared to the Double Barrel Shotgun. However, the tension of carefully managing each round will make the experience even more intense than before.

[h2]4. Conclusion[/h2]

We are currently conducting extensive internal tests to refine and improve the game. This effort extends not only to the Single Barrel Shotgun but also to newly added floors and zombies, all of which are undergoing rigorous evaluation and adjustment.

Our goal is to bring you closer to the day when you can wield this weapon and enjoy combat in Liberty Grand Center.  
We sincerely appreciate the patience and support of all survivors, and we remain committed to delivering an even more polished gaming experience.  

We’ll return soon with more exciting news.  
Thank you.

notes.title: Upcoming Major Updates #1
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors.  

This is Ray, the director of The Midnight Walkers.  

It has already been a month since the public alpha test began. Time really flies.  
During this time, the development team has reviewed your valuable feedback and survey responses and has been working hard to establish a more solid direction for development.  

Today, I’d like to share some confirmed features for the next test, which were finalized after discussions within the development team.  

Although the exact schedule for the next test has not yet been determined, we aim to share it with you soon. Additionally, we confirm our participation in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] in February next year.  

[h2]Parrying and Combat Improvements[/h2]
Yes, a parry system is being implemented. The development team agreed that additional actions were necessary to provide a deeper and more detailed combat experience, and therefore decided to implement the parry system.  

Currently, the parry system is under development, and we expect it to pair well with TMW’s charging attack system.  
We are also revising attack animations to create more tension-filled animations and are diversifying weapon trajectories. Additional combos are also under consideration.  

In summary, the implementation of the parry system will offer a more rhythmic and immersive experience in attack and defense gameplay.  
The charging attack system will complement this by creating richer combat patterns.  

As soon as the prototype is ready, we will share it on [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]Discord[/url].  

[h2]Floor Rotation System[/h2]
In the previous test, you could experience floors from B1F to 7F. Now, you will be able to explore from B1F to 15F.  

Of course, experiencing all 16 floors in a single game would be time-consuming and make it harder to encounter other players.  
To address this, we have devised a floor rotation system where the accessible range changes every 10 minutes.  

The floors will be divided into three ranges:  
- B1F to 7F  
- 4F to 11F  
- 8F to 15F  

This system is being implemented for diversity and is subject to change based on your feedback during playtests.  
Enjoy the expanded Liberty Grand Center environment!  

[h2]Enhanced Crafting System and Grinder[/h2]
To diversify materials and craftable items, we are preparing a new menu called the Workshop.  

Instead of crafting items through merchants, you can now directly access the Workshop menu from the lobby to view all craftable items at a glance.  
This will provide a more convenient crafting experience.  

Additionally, grinders will be scattered throughout Liberty Grand Center.  
Survivors can use these machines to grind items and obtain lower-tier materials.  
Of course, this is only if you successfully extract!  

If you’ve played Rust, this system may feel familiar.  

[h2]Zombie AI Improvements and New Zombie Types[/h2]
We’re improving zombie AI and refining their attack animations.  
Our goal is to make attack motions clearer and give each zombie distinct characteristics.  

The existing zombie group (Walkers, Runners, and Tankers) will be joined by Spitters and Crawlers,  
adding variety and richness to long-range and close-range combat.  
Additionally, a new elite zombie, the Charger, will be introduced.  

Chargers are massive zombies that charge into and disrupt the players’ formations. Stay tuned!  

[h2]New Weapon and Weapon Rebalancing[/h2]
A new two-handed weapon, the Trash Spear, will be added. This melee weapon offers relatively long range, allowing for combat from a safer distance.  

Meanwhile, the Double Barrel Shotgun is being modified to a Single Barrel Shotgun.  
This change is due to the structural advantages the Double Barrel Shotgun had over other firearms, which required adjustments for balance.  

These are some of the confirmed updates the development team has been discussing recently.  
We’ll continue to transparently share updates as we outline our roadmap and vision.  

Thank you for your patience and support as we continue to develop this game.  

Sincerely,  
Director Ray

Additionally, grinders will be scattered throughout Liberty Grand Center.
Survivors can use these machines to grind items and obtain lower-tier materials.
We’re improving zombie AI and refining their attack animations.
The existing zombie group (Walkers, Runners, and Tankers) will be joined by Spitters and Crawlers,
Additionally, a new elite zombie, the Charger, will be introduced.
A new two-handed weapon, the Trash Spear, will be added.

notes.title: Dev Log #9
notes.content:
[h2]1. Masterpiece Weapons[/h2]

Masterpiece weapons are not just simple equipment.  
They are true treasures in the game that combine the best artistry and functionality.  
Created with rare materials and intricate designs, these weapons are not merely tools for winning battles but symbols of a survivor's unique style.  
Our dev team ensures that these weapons live up to the name "Masterpiece," allowing you to feel their uniqueness the moment you hold one.  
Beyond delivering powerful damage, these weapons will stand as a force to instill fear in your enemies within Liberty Grand Center.

[h2]2. Features of Masterpiece Weapons[/h2]

[h3][Unique Abilities][/h3]  
Masterpiece weapons are not just about increasing stats; each weapon offers unique abilities that stand out on the battlefield.  
For example, the Masterpiece bow features a distinctive ability to ignite arrows, setting the battlefield ablaze.  
In the concept art below, you can see the red marking in the center, which is designed to enable this fire-igniting ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/1933298c760fef771b18149d138d7162d68e07ec.png[/img]  

In the future, we may expand this functionality to include other elements such as poison or lightning, providing diverse options for players.  

[h3][Unique Appearance][/h3]  
Masterpiece weapons also boast exceptional designs, making them highly collectible.  
These designs are not only functional but also offer visual enjoyment to survivors.  
When others see you wielding one of these Masterpiece weapons, they won’t be able to hide their envy.  

Here’s an early concept art of a Masterpiece one-handed blunt weapon:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/e9259751fe74e68db8f9d71822d7db264d696c14.png[/img]  

But be careful, other survivors may stop at nothing to steal your stunning Masterpiece weapon.  

[h3][How to Get][/h3]  
As the Masterpiece weapon system is still in the planning phase, the exact acquisition methods have not been finalized yet.  
However, since Masterpiece weapons will be rated above Legendary, we plan to set the acquisition difficulty relatively high.  
For instance, we are considering methods such as combining rare materials dropped by special zombies with components sold at high prices by merchants.

[h2]3. Anticipation for Masterpiece Weapons[/h2]

Masterpiece weapons are more than just items; they aim to make your gaming experience more enjoyable.  
In the future, these weapons will provide new strategies and fun while becoming a powerful and unique presence in the game.  

Next time, we’ll share the finalized concept art and models for the Masterpiece bow. Please look forward to it!  
And if you have great ideas, feel free to share them on our [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]official Discord[/url]!  
Our development team is always eager for your feedback :)

notes.title: Announcement of the next dev milestone
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,
This is Ray, the director of The Midnight Walkers.
We began development in early August last year, conducted our first closed alpha test in May of this year, and recently ran our first public alpha test.

We received far more applicants for testing than expected—over ten times our initial estimate of 2,000. I want to take this opportunity to thank each of you for your incredible interest in The Midnight Walkers.

The alpha test was certainly full of ups and downs. Given the short development period and our desire to showcase as much as possible, there were several areas that fell short and unforeseen issues that impacted some players, resulting in the loss of precious time and items.

Despite these challenges, your patience and willingness to enjoy the game were invaluable, and we deeply appreciate it.

As we mentioned, we aim not to rely on "early access" as a shield but instead to improve and strengthen as many aspects of the game as possible from the start.

The unsatisfactory experiences from this test will be transformed into special and enjoyable gameplay that truly rewards you.

Our focus in this test was to verify and monitor the technical aspects and gameplay routines.

[i]The key focuses for our next development milestone are as follows:[/i]

[h2]1. Enhancing Core Fun and Unique Features of The Midnight Walkers[/h2]
Currently, Liberty Grand Center is composed of 8 floors, but we plan to expand it to over 20 floors. The development team has already built up to the 14th floor, and we are considering options for matchmaking through floor rotation or defining floor ranges while maintaining the current 8-floor rotation.

With the increase in floors, players can expect to experience various themes such as fitness clubs, spas, and casinos, allowing for more diverse gameplay environments. We are focused on crafting detailed gameplay experiences on each floor.

We also plan to improve the overall combat experience. Initially, due to rapid development, we missed several opportunities to revamp the combat system. Now, we aim to enhance the thrill of combat by redesigning attack motions and solidifying the unique characteristics of each weapon, providing more engaging offense and defense interactions.

Of course, zombies will play a central role in these improvements. We are upgrading AI patterns to create more satisfying combat encounters with zombies, and new zombie types will be introduced. These include zombies that spit tumor-like projectiles from a distance and others that target players' lower bodies by moving without their lower halves.

Based on our monitoring from this test, we will also improve UX to provide a more convenient experience, while focusing on a UI design that highlights the unique characteristics of The Midnight Walkers.

[h2]2. Balance[/h2]
While class distinctions are important, creating realistic combat situations is our priority, and we will now pay closer attention to fine-tuning each class. Active skills and perks will continue to be added to each class, with new abilities that will solidify each class’s unique traits.

We are moving from a phase focused on feature development to one centered on gameplay, so for the next test, we plan to conduct extensive PVE and PVP testing within the development team to create even more enjoyable combat experiences.

[h2]3. Reinforcing the Game Cycle[/h2]
The next test will be longer than a week, so we will work on enhancing the gameplay life cycle to ensure lasting enjoyment throughout the testing period.

This process will involve improvements to the crafting system, and, if resources permit, the introduction of a mission (Quest) system.

[h2]4. Technical Improvements and User-Friendly UX[/h2]
For the next test, we plan to implement a more precise anti-cheat system, build upon data gathered from this test, and make structural adjustments to provide a more stable server environment.

While it was challenging to test alongside everyone over the five-day period, the development team and I had a great time. We felt a range of emotions throughout the process.

Our team will now take time to reorganize and focus on development for the next test. We will continue to share the development process and communicate openly, as we have until now.

Thank you again to all testers who participated in the first alpha test of The Midnight Walkers!

Sincerely,
Director Ray and the One-Way Ticket Studio Development Team

notes.title: Devlog#7
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors.
We would like to introduce the new class, the 'Bartender', who shakes a cocktail shaker even in the midst of Liberty Grand Center, full of zombies and enemies!
This character is not just a simple supporter. The Bartender can craft various drinks to empower their teammates, and at times, ignite their own blood to deliver powerful attacks on enemies as a versatile close-range warrior.
Look forward to seeing how the "Bartender who refreshes everyone's throats and heats up their hearts" will change your battles!
[b]The Bartender class is not final and may have its specs changed in future updates.[/b]

[h2][Character Concept and Design][/h2]
The Bartender is a character known as the "Cheerful Drinker." As the name suggests, they maintain a carefree attitude even in bleak environments. [b]Their specialty is drinking their own crafted drinks to unleash immense power or using those drinks to aid teammates.[/b] You will never see a Bartender grim-faced in battle! They always ask with a smile, "What would you like to drink today?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/68d3f8d7510c0b27ce469db051aa9baf63d96fbc.png[/img]

[h2][Unique Skill (Drink Crafting) System][/h2]
The Bartender's unique skill is their special drink crafting system. Like a chef, they can combine ingredients to craft special drinks. They can [b]power up teammates with an ‘Attack Boost Drink’,[/b] make them [b]invincible with a ‘Defense Boost Drink’,[/b] or sometimes toss a [b]‘Poison Drink’ to debilitate enemies.[/b] The fun lies in crafting the right drink for the situation and using it just like shaking a cocktail shaker.
To craft a drink, input the recipe by pressing the [←], [↑], [→], [↓] keys in the correct order. Once the drink is complete, press [F] to drink it yourself, or allow others to interact with it by pressing [F], or throw it at a target with a right-click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/67e317060ce33897c8ea5b959a893c02c59edb54.png[/img]

[h3]① Ingredient Storage[/h3]
The first step in crafting drinks is the ingredient storage. Here, the Bartender can store and manage various ingredients used for crafting.

[b]● Ingredient List:[/b]
Bearberries, garlic, and chives are distinguished by their unique colors and icons, each providing different effects. For example, bearberries are used for healing recipes, while garlic is for strengthening.

[b]● Ingredient Capacity and Recovery Rate:[/b]
The storage capacity (e.g., 24/25) shows the current available ingredients, and only 25 total ingredients can be carried into the game.

[b]● Ingredient Replenishment:[/b]
Ingredients can be replenished through interaction in the field, and even if a player fails an extraction, basic ingredients will still be provided.

This system forms the foundation of the Bartender's drink crafting, and players must manage their ingredients efficiently to execute their unique recipes.

[h3]② Drink Crafting Recipes[/h3]
The second step is the drink crafting recipes. The Bartender can create special drinks through various combinations, which can be consumed by the Bartender or provided to others.

[b]● Recipe Tree:[/b] The recipe tree connects various drinks, allowing players to craft desired drinks by arranging ingredients. Each recipe has specific effects, and can be enhanced based on the character's traits.

[b]● Recipe Combinations:[/b] Drink effects vary based on the combinations, and skilled Bartenders can craft drinks that suit the team's situation.

[b]● Recipe Management:[/b] Slot 2 stores the in-game recipes. These cannot be changed in-game and must be set in the out-game interface before entering the battlefield. Players must prepare recipes tailored to the battlefield before the match begins.

[b]● Crafting Process:[/b] Drink crafting requires casting time, during which the Bartender mixes ingredients to complete the drink.
This system is crucial to the Bartender's battle strategy, with the effectiveness of the drinks highly dependent on the combinations used.

[h3]③ Skill List[/h3]
The final stage is the skill list. The Bartender can use crafted drinks to activate various skills, allowing them to dominate the battlefield.

[b]● Skill List and Effects:[/b]
The skill list features skills of varying grades, each requiring specific ingredient combinations for different effects. For example, the "Heart of Steel" skill provides high defense and resistance.

[b]● Ingredient Requirements:[/b]
Each skill requires specific combinations of ingredients, and higher-grade skills require more complex combinations.

[b]● Skill Management:[/b]
The skill list in Slot 3 is also managed in the out-game interface. Players can set which recipes to bring into the battle beforehand, ensuring they are prepared for various situations on the battlefield.

[h2][Active Skills][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/d2815875f5a0a1cd534c0cfb5a2fb64ed56609b0.png[/img]

[b]① Party Time:[/b]
"Shout in joy to increase movement speed by 15% and casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds."
This skill allows the Bartender to control the battlefield atmosphere and give the team an advantage. Use it before battle to boost team speed and attack.

[b]② Sweet Champagne:[/b]
Spray from a champagne bottle set on the ground to restore 5 HP per second to allies within 1.5m for 7 seconds.
This skill helps restore teammates’ HP in intense battles, turning the tide in your favor.

[b]③ Drink Enchant:[/b]
Coat a weapon with a toxic drink or smash a bottle to deal fixed damage and apply a poison debuff to nearby enemies.
This skill goes beyond just an attack, adding a poison debuff that drains enemy health over time.

[b]④ Drink Crafting:[/b]
Mix various ingredients to create a drink with specific effects. Drinks can be consumed or thrown, and their effects depend on the ingredients and order used. Players can maximize the drink's performance through special recipes.

[h2][Future Plans][/h2]
The Bartender you can experience in this public playtest is not the final version.
We plan to refine the drink crafting system to be more fun and creative, allowing for more varied combinations based on the situation. We will also add special events or animations during the crafting process to enhance this character’s unique playstyle. Based on your feedback, we will continue developing the Bartender to become the heart of team play.

"Take a moment to relax, even on the battlefield!" Meet the Bartender in the upcoming public playtest.

notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

We are excited to announce the new features and improvements coming in the upcoming first public playtest. Please see the details below:

[h3][New Zombies][/h3] 
● Riot Walker & Delivery Runner: Encounter zombies equipped with riot gear and helmets. 
● These new zombies have enhanced defense and attack capabilities.

● Use the “Drink Mixing” skill to change the flow of battle. ● Customize this skill in the Unique Skill tab.

[h3][Crafting System][/h3] 
● Improved crafting system: Crafted items will now appear in the new “Completed Crafting” section. Make sure to collect your crafted items!

In addition to the updates listed above, various other content has been improved and adjusted. Join us for the first public test starting in just 5 days to experience the new content firsthand, and please share your feedback with us on [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]The Midnight Walkers Discord[/url]. notes.title: Devlog#6
notes.content:
Survivors, are you ready to uncover the hidden secrets of Liberty Grand Center?
In this dev log, we’re excited to introduce a new Lock and Unlock System that will provide you with a more strategic and immersive experience.

You’re about to face challenges beyond just defeating enemies. Now, you have the chance to find special keys or keycards to unlock doors and safes hidden throughout Liberty Grand Center, leading to exciting rewards.
Should you open every door you come across? Well, the treasure behind them may be tremendous, or you might encounter a powerful threat, no one knows for sure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/04f291dafa07b11c439a04243dcc64139bb0c01e.png[/img]
[b]※Who knows? There might be something hidden behind the Tomato Statue※[/b]

[h2][Key Elements of the Unlock System][/h2]
The unlock system is designed to take your gameplay to the next level, adding depth to the game beyond just combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/3b71d114c84ab2c65a99b4025444eb5ff0336fcf.png[/img]

The types of safes will become more varied over time.
The designs are not final and may be subject to change.
[h3]●A New Experience of Finding Hidden Treasures:[/h3]
Instead of simply finding items, you’ll now be able to use special keys and keycards to unlock doors and safes and discover the treasures hidden inside.
Where you choose to use the key will be a significant decision.
Perhaps you’ll unlock the door to a [b]secret lab[/b], only to find yourself facing a powerful zombie.

[h3]●The Importance of Choice:[/h3]
Remember, a single choice can change your fate.
While you may find some of the best treasures hidden in Liberty Grand Center, terrifying enemies might be lurking as well.
No one can guarantee that opening a locked area is the right decision.

[h2][Development Details][/h2]

[h3]● How to Use Items:[/h3]
Once you obtain an unlock item, approach any locked door or safe.
[b]Some locked objects will have a longer interaction time, requiring the survivor’s full concentration until the door finally opens.[/b]
If you let your guard down while opening the door, surrounding enemies may strike at any moment.

[h3]● Interaction and Visual Effects:[/h3]
As you attempt to unlock a door or safe, an interaction timer will appear, showing the process of unlocking the object.
If you approach the lock with the wrong item, a message indicating the key mismatch will be displayed.
On the other hand, when you succeed, the door or safe will open, and you’ll face whatever is hidden behind it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/64eab357a7b6111785e9a479cf0ea16f5cf98ba4.png[/img]

Left image: No unlock item available for the locked door
Right image: Unlock item available for the locked door
[b]- Click or enlarge the image for a detailed view.[/b]
[b]- This image is a placeholder for understanding the system.[/b]
[h3]● Game Economy: [/h3]
Unlock items are not just one-time consumables.
They can be bought and sold via the in-game marketplace.
The rare key you find may hold immense value among other survivors.
For example, one key might be the [i][b]only key to access a location where a powerful zombie is sleeping[/b][/i], so be cautious when trading it.

[h3]● Unlock Items (Keycards and Keys): [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/2ea645c04c19fc94ed73bb48ee708b67e5fb1297.png[/img]
These aren’t just regular security cards.
Keycards serve as critical keys that grant survivors access to the hidden secrets within Liberty Grand Center.
Without a keycard, [i][b]you won’t be able to reach some of the most important places in Liberty Grand Center.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/8706765775e4cd728a1bb3337fbc1beb81d17008.png[/img]
While the keys may seem familiar, the [b]The Midnight Walkers logo[/b] and Mogenco corporation logo engraved on them symbolize much more than just unlocking mechanisms. These keys are directly connected to [i][b]key elements of the game’s lore[/b][/i].

Soon, you’ll encounter an even greater variety of locked doors and safes, with [b]powerful enemies and unimaginable rewards hidden inside.[/b]
Where will you use your key? That decision is [b]yours[/b].

notes.title: 2024 Q4 ~ 2025 Q1 Development Schedule
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors.

We would like to share our plans for the first quarter of next year after our recent private technical test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/108ca088c5c2ba3fec0b006134eab93c524f37af.png[/img]

There was some change in the schedule. 
We had originally wanted to participate in the Steam Next Fest coming this October but have [b]shifted it to February 2025[/b]. notes.title: Devlog#5
notes.content:
In this development log, we will introduce the zombie design rework of The Midnight Walkers.

[h2][Design Concept][/h2]
The zombie characters that have been redesigned this time are based on occupations that can be frequently seen in the zombie world, and the goal is to provide a more realistic and intuitive sense of fear.
We are trying to increase the immersion in the game by turning real occupations such as firefighter zombies, police zombies, rider zombies, and high-class zombies into zombies while dealing with zombies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/362fba8a947b9e40e5fb78ce073bbbebb5944cb0.png[/img]

[h2][External Characteristics and Story][/h2]
*The zombie story is not finalized and may change during the development process.*

[h3]● Firefighter Costume Zombie[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/dc34f375d7d14defab07ecd714171471336857d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/a14a556fd5ef3a2878dae329859e0c6da160f086.png[/img]

[b][i]- Appearance:[/i][/b]
They wear fire suits and helmets, and have burn marks.
They move clumsily due to their heavy equipment, but are designed to look like they have high defense or health.

[b][i]- Story:[/i][/b]
They were originally under Mr. Nobody. However, they rebelled due to their dissatisfaction with Mr. Nobody, but were eventually subdued and punished by being put in charge of maintenance work for the survival show held at Liberty Grand Center.
While preparing to renovate and reopen the place after the survival show ended, they were infected by zombies that were left behind while artificially introducing zombies into the show or while putting out a fire that had spread with Molotov cocktails.
However, there is no need for sympathy. They are not honorable beings.
Their greed and betrayal caused internal divisions within the Mr. Nobody organization, and their downfall was self-inflicted.
In the zombie world, the scariest thing is not zombies. It is people.

[h3]● Front and Military Uniform Zombie[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/43aa69d943ecf8d2bd13cae9777234eb2b4ef0c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/b18e1fdae8872ec1ae3adfc6078b72419a6eac9d.png[/img]

[i][b]- Appearance: [/b][/i]
They have traces of wearing bulletproof vests, helmets, and military gear, and their rotten skin is characteristic.
They are designed to look difficult to deal with because of their job characteristics of military training and combat gear.

[i][b]- Story: [/b][/i]
They made a living as mercenary soldiers or riot squads during their lifetime, and acted as the main military force of Mr. Nobody. After the spread of the virus, they were hired to suppress riots and coups, and played a key role in maintaining order under Mr. Nobody's power.
However, in the process, there were personnel who suffered serious injuries from unexpected accidents or were attacked by zombies, and Mr. Nobody showed cruelty by turning them into zombies instead of killing them and using them for survival shows.
This is because survival shows always need zombies.
As they were once powerful beings who protected Liberty Grand Center, it is said that survival shows became very difficult to survive and escape after they were turned into zombies.

[h3]● Rider Costume Zombie[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/0db3a51e18817590406277e73f6818358bda78ea.png[/img]

[i][b]- Appearance:[/b][/i]
Designed to look like a fast-moving zombie wearing a bicycle helmet and light sports clothing.

[i][b]- Story:[/b][/i]
They are in charge of light material supply at Liberty Grand Center, and their primary means of transportation is bicycles.
In the world of The Midnight Walkers, electric vehicles are so valuable that they are only used when moving large quantities of materials or high-ranking officials, and general material deliveries are made by bicycle. They are responsible for quickly delivering important resources and information by bicycle.
Success brought great rewards, but failure brought a cruel fate of death or transformation into a zombie.
Before the infection, they were a vital link between survivors, playing a key role in delivering resources and information between other survivor camps and Liberty Grand Center. Success in delivering brought them great fame and rewards, but they paid a harsh price in the form of zombie transformation due to unexpected or intentional accidents.

[h3]● High-end Clothing Zombie[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/3c62452a611ab594b443157882d5e3054ba91a3f.png[/img]

[i][b]- Appearance:[/b][/i]
His once clean purple shirt, vest, and suit pants are now torn and dirty, hinting at his pre-infection social status. The glowing red eyes indicate that the infection has progressed, and the large body is designed to feel like a threatening presence capable of making slow but powerful attacks.

[i][b]- Story:[/b][/i]
This zombie is a high-ranking figure who fell victim to a power struggle at Liberty Grand Center.
In life, he played a prominent role in the community due to his resources and power, but he was pushed out of the internal power struggle and became the target of a conspiracy. His rivals deliberately infected him in order to eliminate him, and the person he trusted most was his wife.
For many years, he trusted her as his companion and political partner, but his wife secretly plotted to gain power for him. Eventually, she colluded with his enemies and forcibly threw him into the zombie horde.
He struggled to survive, but was eventually transformed into a zombie, and now he had no choice but to show the survivors his anger toward the wife he once trusted.

[h2][Planning and Development Intention][/h2]
The zombies that have been reworked this time have not yet been confirmed in terms of their detailed stats, such as their functions and health.
The zombies' stories are also the same.
Currently, we are focusing only on the external changes to provide a visually new experience.
This is to flexibly develop the zombies' abilities and characteristics by collecting various feedbacks from the upcoming playtests.

In addition, we plan to measure the psychological effect of the zombies' appearances on gameplay through A/B testing of the existing zombies and the zombies with the reworked design. Through this process, we plan to secure basic data for adjusting the game balance and scaling the difficulty.

Currently, the appearance has simply changed, but the roles and stats of each zombie may be specified based on the test results in the future. Through this, we plan to design certain zombies to play a more important tactical role in the game.

[h2][Conclusion and Future Development Plans][/h2]
We are currently improving the abilities and visual details of various zombie characters, and testing the challenges and threats each zombie will present to survivors in the game.
We will continue to update the various zombie types to further enhance the abilities and visuals of zombies through additional feedback, and to provide players with new combat strategies.
We would appreciate your participation in the upcoming playtest and various feedback.

notes.title: Technical Test Results Report
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors!

The recent technical test has successfully concluded with your enthusiastic participation.
First and foremost, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone who participated in the test.
Thanks to your valuable feedback and data, we had an important opportunity to further enhance the quality of the game.
Below is an overview and analysis of the collected data.

[h2][Created Accounts and Characters][/h2]

As a result of the test, a [b]total of 878 accounts[/b] were created, and through these, [b]1,440 characters[/b] were generated.
In particular, the distribution of characters by class is as follows:

[h3]● Assaulter: [b]523 (36%)[/b][/h3]
[h3]● Crow: [b]443 (31%)[/b][/h3]
[h3]● Trapper: [b]474 (33%)[/b][/h3]

This character distribution shows how survivors perceive the characteristics and strategic roles of each class within the game.
The fact that the Assaulter class was the most selected suggests that its aggressive playstyle and combat abilities were particularly appealing to many survivors.
On the other hand, Crow and Trapper seem to have formed a dedicated fan base due to their unique tactical versatility and utility.

From this data, our dev team has gained valuable insights into the appeal and balance of each class.
Based on this, we will analyze the reasons behind the varying levels of class popularity and make balance adjustments as necessary to create a more balanced gaming environment.

[h2][Highest Levels and Top Survivors][/h2]

During this test, two players achieved the highest level of 20, and the top survivors are as follows:

[h3][b]● bumrae1 (Assaulter)[/b]: 194,788 XP[/h3]
[h3][b]● Cosmic (Assaulter)[/b]: 192,894 XP[/h3]

These players demonstrated exceptional skill and consistent gameplay, reaching the highest level and leaving a significant mark within the game.

[h2][Items Sold in the Marketplace and Their Quantities][/h2]

Additionally, during the test, 
[b]268 items were put up for sale[/b], and 
[b]a total of 1,726 items were successfully sold in the marketplace[/b].
This level of active trading has been invaluable in assessing the functioning and balance of the economic system.

Through this test, we have gained several important insights.
Using these insights, we will conduct an in-depth analysis of class balance, economic system stability, and how survivors interact within the game.
We will continue to refine the game and establish a direction for improvement, striving to provide an even better gaming experience.

In future tests and the official service, we will reflect the outcomes of this test to ensure a more polished game.
We ask for your continued interest and support, and we look forward to seeing you again with an improved version of the game at the Steam Next Fest in October.

Once again, thank you to everyone who participated in the test :)
Thank you.

notes.title: Dev Log #1: Escape Pod Tracker
notes.content:
[b][h2]Dev Log #1[/h2][/b]

Welcome to the first dev log of "The Midnight Walkers." This time, we're introducing the Escape Pod Tracker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/bbde4a0e803049285788b5f21b1a45d4067e80a7.png[/img][b]Escape Pod Tracker Concept Art[/b]

This device is the only means to survive in Liberty Grand Center, allowing you to track escape pods. If you don't want to use an activated escape pod immediately, you can extract and store the escape code from the activated escape pod. Stored escape codes can be used to activate inactive escape pods.

[h2]Device Design and Functionality[/h2]
The Escape Pod Tracker features a retro design reminiscent of classic handheld gaming devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/d68f96a4def695a2e7dd888b4bb063263b21d0eb.png[/img][b]Escape Pod Tracker Modeling Image[/b]

Key features and design elements are as follows:

[b][h3][Visual Design][/h3][/b]
This device has a compact, handheld design with a digital screen that displays crucial information. The unique antenna and tape-fixed battery case give it a rugged, makeshift feel, enhancing the game's apocalyptic atmosphere.

[b][h3][Display and Interface][/h3][/b]
The use of tape and anchoring clips for securing components reflects the urgency and resourcefulness in an apocalyptic setting. The UI is simple yet functional, featuring a radar-style interface that easily visualizes nearby escape pods.

[b][h3][In-Game Functionality][/h3][/b]
The main display shows the number of nearby escape pods and the distance based on your location. The circular meter darkens as you approach an escape pod. As mentioned earlier, you can extract and store the escape code from activated escape pods. These stored codes can then be used to activate other inactive escape points. This feature allows you to strategically use escape routes, enhancing your chances of survival during crises or when obtaining high-tier items.

[b][h3][References][/h3][/b]
The design draws inspiration from classic handheld devices, merging nostalgic charm with modern gameplay mechanics. The layout and button configuration, inspired by the Game Boy, brings vintage appeal to the gameplay experience.

[b][h3][In-Game Video][/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=DJ5yDGEnlyE;full][/previewyoutube]

As the development of "The Midnight Walkers" continues, the Escape Pod Tracker will undergo further testing and refinement. Our goal is to ensure that this device not only seamlessly integrates into our world but also provides intuitive and essential gameplay information, enhancing the overall player experience.

We will continue to share more updates and insights in future dev logs. Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

notes.content:
Hello, Survivors! This is Director Ray.
I has some exciting news about our next plans that we promised to share.
First, our first closed pre-alpha test, which ran from May 8th to 11th, has concluded, and we sincerely thank you for your valuable feedback.
Your enthusiasm for The Midnight Walkers, as shown in the survey, has been incredibly encouraging for our dev team!

[b][h2][Key Survey Results][/h2][/b]
In response to the question, "Are you interested in playing The Midnight Walkers again during its next test or launch?" an impressive 98.9% of users expressed their willingness to participate!
To the question, "Would you recommend The Midnight Walkers to a friend or acquaintance for the next test or launch?" 95.21% of users gave positive feedback!
We are committed to meeting your expectations and delivering a high-quality game.
Now, let's dive into our major update plans!

[b][h2]#1 Zombie Updates[/h2][/b]
[h3]AI and Action and Motion[/h3]
- Renewing the zombie AI and improving animations to offer a more engaging combat experience with zombies. Hunting zombies alone will be a delightful game experience.
- All zombie animations will be updated by motion capture.

[h3]New Zombies and Powerful Boss Zombies[/h3]
- Howler will be added. This attracts other zombies and immobilizes survivors with its screams.
- Boss zombie will appear in the hidden area of the new underground parking lot. (Need a security card to access this area)
- Runner and Walker zombies will be redesigned.

[b][h2]#2 Map and Level Design[/h2][/b]
[h3]Addition of New Concept Maps (Floors)[/h3]
- New maps, such as the Lounge Club and Underground Parking Lot, will be added.
- In-progress Shopping Mall map will also be completed.

[h3]Level Design and Distinct Atmosphere[/h3]
- Each floor will have a distinct theme with unique lighting and ambiance.
- Hidden farming points and unique loot specific to each floor's concept.

[b][h2]#3 Enhanced Farming Experience[/h2][/b]
[h3]Various Farming Boxes[/h3]
- Add a variety of boxes that fit the apocalypse setting, such as toolboxes, weapon boxes, military boxes, and body bags.

[h3]Farming System[/h3]
- Reduce the interaction time with boxes and add item appraisal times.
- Circular icons will appear when interactable boxes or items are nearby, making them easier to spot.
- The background of item icons in the inventory will reflect their rarity.

[b][h2]#4 Escape System[/h2][/b]
[h3]Extraction System for Escape Pods[/h3]
- When an escape pod appears, you can extract a [Power Cartridge] from it, allowing you to activate a deactivated escape pod and escape at any time.
- Use the extracted [Power Cartridge] on a deactivated escape pod to escape with your squad members immediately.

[h3]Public Escape Elevator[/h3]
- Hidden emergency escape elevator that can accommodate up to three people will be added.
- Essential items will be required to activate it.

[h3]Container System[/h3]
- Even if you can't escape, the container will secure your important items.

[b][h2]#5 New Weapons and Equipment[/h2][/b]
[h3]Character Appearance Changes[/h3]
- Your character's appearance will now change based on the armor equipped on each part, allowing you to gauge the level of your opponent's armor during encounters.

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
- New weapons such as the trash spear and dagger will be added.
- Throwable weapons like Molotov cocktails and additional trap items will be added.
- Class-specific weapons will be more detailed.

[h3]Advanced Balancing of Weapons[/h3]
- Rebalance existing weapons in addition to introducing new ones.
- Fix issues where ranged weapons dealt abnormal damage and adjust the overall balance.

[b][h2]#6 New Class and Balance Updates[/h2][/b]
[h3]New Class: [Bartender][/h3]
- Bartender who makes special drinks using folk remedies and secret recipes will be introduced.
- The special drinks made with the bartender's secret recipes in their exclusive flask will empower squads and inflict pain on enemies.

[h3]Renewal and Advanced Balancing of Existing Classes[/h3]
- The Technician will be renamed.
- Various active skills and perks will be added to all classes.
- Minimize unreasonable gameplay experiences by rebalancing the overall PVE and PVP balance.

[b][h2]#7 Out Game Content[/h2][/b]
[h3]Marketplace System[/h3]
- Survivors will be able to sell and purchase various equipment and material items through the marketplace.

[h3]Crafting System[/h3]
- The existing crafting system will be improved to become a crafting workshop.
- More diverse equipment and items can be created by collecting unique materials.

[b][h2]#8 Matchmaking Rule Updates[/h2][/b]
[h3]Improved Solo and Duo/Trio Matching[/h3]
- Solo and duo/trio matchmaking will be separated, but solo players can join duo/trio matches.
- Solo matches will start with fewer players, and the floor range will be smaller accordingly.
    - Example: Duo/Trio matches use 10 floors, while solo matches use 5-7 floors (TBD).

[b][h2]#9 General Gameplay Experience[/h2][/b]
[h3]Sound Play Experience[/h3]
- Fine-tune all elements sound balancing and spatial awareness to enable more detailed sound play.

[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
- Minimize unnecessary operations and redesign the UX for intuitive controls.
- UI improvements will also be made alongside the UX enhancements.

[h3] Bullet Removal Feature[/h3]
- Removal of bullets from loaded guns.

These are the main updates we have prepared. There are also various other improvements not listed here.
We cannot share the exact schedule for the next test yet, as our dev team is still finalizing the dev schedule.
However, we will strive to plan the next test as soon as possible and continue to communicate with you about new content and improvements throughout the dev process.

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BLtdYG2LQ6M;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello, survivors!
We've finally released our pre-alpha gameplay teaser, which is made with real gameplay and shows off new weapons and new characters.
Midnight Walkers is being made in Unreal 5, and we're gearing up for a closed pre-alpha test on April 26-28. If you're interested in testing, you can sign up on our Discord channel (signup form will open in late March).
Until then, we'll be back with more news at the end of March!
Thank you!
